name: ArchWeave Agent
description: Turns a prompt into an enterprise-styled static architecture, sequence, workflow, dataflow or lifecycle diagram as SVG code, following ArchWeave conventions. The user renders the SVG to PNG locally with finish.ps1.

conversation_starters.title: Reference architecture
conversation_starters.text: Draw the Warm standby deployment view for rag-chatbot as an architecture diagram.

conversation_starters.title: Request sequence
conversation_starters.text: Draw the request sequence for an external partner API through Cloudflare, external APIM and App Service.

conversation_starters.title: Golden Path workflow
conversation_starters.text: Draw the Golden Path intake-to-go-live workflow for an internal API, with owner lanes and the hand-offs removed.

conversation_starters.title: Telemetry dataflow
conversation_starters.text: Draw the dataflow from App Service diagnostics to Microsoft Sentinel via Log Analytics and Event Hubs, with required log fields.
